items.title: Abbey Lincoln — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: She was married to Stokely Carmichael and the president of Guinea was also her patron and Hugh Macekala was her second husband, always would be, you know.

ctx.x: Yeah. And she said to me, "Would you like to go to Africa, take a trip to Africa?" I said, "Oh, Miriam." She said, "I pay your ticket, you know," and she did. She took me to Africa first class. She introduced me to the president of Guinea the first morning and he gave me my name Aminata, and she introduced me to a lifestyle. It was all about protocol. I had never hung with government people before, you know, and she took me with her everywhere. I was like her lady-in-waiting. She told them I was an actress. She…
Is that an American problem, do you think?
